Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the inquiry — excited to work on this for the AI Summit. Attached is an initial vendor quote (BrassStitch_Q3_quote_0725.pdf) with unit pricing for: enamel pins, embroidered hoodies, crew tees (50/50), drawstring backpacks, and a small run of silicon phone wallets.

Lead times: most items are 7–10 business days from art approval. Note: we’re seeing a partial backorder risk on the enamel pin plating batch (estimated 10% backorder on the matte black finish).

Rush options: we can prioritize the order with a 48–72 hour production bump for an additional 18% setup/rush fee and overnight freight.

Please confirm:
- Final quantities per SKU (we used the numbers in the quote as placeholders)
- Art approvals (we can provide mockups once you confirm sizes/colors)
- Ship-to address (we can ship to your office or direct to the convention center; venue deliveries need a contact name and date on file)

Attachments: BrassStitch_Q3_quote_0725.pdf (quote, pricing, terms)

Best,

Hi Tessa,

Appreciate the details. Attached are: a revised quote (line-itemed) and a first-pass mockup for the sweatshirt and pin (sweatshirt_mock_v3.png). Notes:
- Hoodie sizing: we recommend keeping a 60/30/10 M/L/XL split in the final print run to reduce returns.
- Enamel pins: the matte-black plating is low stock; we can switch to antique nickel with no lead time impact, or keep matte black with an expected 10% short-fill.
- Express freight: $420 flat for overnight within CA; express production + setup = +18% as noted.

If you confirm antique nickel for the pin and sign the art proof, we can schedule production to ship 14 Jul via overnight to arrive 15 Jul by 10:00.
